issues.title: OmniRush has been under maintenance since November 3, 2026 — Unable to use the coding agent

Recurring message dispatch errors ("Bad request", "An error occurred", "Under maintenance", "No connection")
[Bug]: Clicking a file named without its path in chat opens nothing (should open the highest matching workspace file)
Quote chip expansion can swallow adjacent text into the quote or stop working
[Feature]: The artifact panel header shows only the file name, never its path
[Bug]: The side panel forgets its width after it is closed and reopened

latest_release.name: OmniRush.ai v3.8.4
latest_release.body:
### New
- Claude chats no longer need the sandbox. When the project has no sandbox, or it is turned off, Claude Code runs on this computer. With the sandbox on, nothing changes.
